name: DDRK Omega sampler
plain: One sampler for Flow Matching and EDM, routing steps by phase: integrator choice from Euler, Heun, RK4, or its own one-call multistep HC2 and HC3. Layered with a latent fuse (SABER), ancestral renoise, restart inserts, sharpening and a schedule adapter. Auto mode tweaks params by step count.
math:
HC2: exponential-style update in λ=−log σ (EDM) or log((1−σ)/σ) (flow), with φ₂ weights and a derivative of x0 from history; limiter_kappa bounds it. free_corrector redoes the last step by interpolation, UniC-style, at zero cost.
Phases 1,2,3 via AdaptivePhaseRouter; auto picks rk4 for curvature>0.15 with ≥10 steps, heun for >0.05, else hc2.
Flow SDE in phase 1: _ancestral_split_flow. Restart: _insert_restarts in window [0.10,0.35]σ_max. Only key routing and hc2 head were read, tableaux not checked.

props.order: up to 4 via rk4; hc2 order 2
props.prediction_space: x0 in λ for HC2; d for RK
